title: Java web-API interface with ChatGPT
summary: Senior electrical and computer engineering students select a web API and build a Java interface that retrieves, parses, and displays its data. Instructors encourage ChatGPT at every stage; students also prepare a presentation and tutorial and report how they used the tool.
